text:
incident-bot: PAGER: SEV2 -> Billing pipeline: ingestion backlog + customer overage flags firing. Detected at 2026-03-10T15:02Z. Pager sent to @oncall. Link: https://console.redwood/incident/1769456123
Priya Patel: I'm on it — joining thread. Observed spike in Kafka consumer lag for topic `metering-events` and a surge of `overage_flag` events queued for downstream.
Jamal Rivera: oncall here, reading logs now. Any obvious deploys around 14:50Z?
Sofia Chen: I see a failed rollout in metering-reader at 14:48Z — crashloop caused by a dependency bump on the tokenizer library. Might explain token-count mismatch.
Priya Patel: Good catch. Crash caused consumer to repeatedly restart and fall behind. Two problems: (1) delayed ingestion (lag backlog) -> delayed usage reports, (2) token count drift from tokenizer bump -> incorrect per-request token counts, some customers got overage flags.
Marcus Li: Customer success is pinging about accounts with overage notices. I'll mute automated overage emails once we confirm scope. @customer-success-bot can you hold outbound overage emails?
customer-success-bot: Acknowledged. Pausing overage email workflow for billing region eu-west-1.
Jamal Rivera: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Pause enforcement of overage thresholds (feature flag). 2) Stabilize metering-reader (rollback tokenizer dep). 3) Drain backlog via controlled reprocessing. 4) Recompute token counts for affected window and backfill billing records. 5) Postmortem & customer outreach.
Priya Patel: I'm flipping FF `billing.enforce_overages` to false now.
Priya Patel: /run: curl -X POST https://config.redwood/flags/billing.enforce_overages -d '{"value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'
Priya Patel: done — flag false. Confirmed enforcement suspended. :white_check_mark:
Marcus Li: Thanks. CS will stop further escalation for now. I'll compile list of accounts that received an overage flag in the last 3 hours.
Sofia Chen: For stabilization, recommend rolling back metering-reader to v2.1.8 (last known good) and scaling it to 4 replicas to catch up.
Jamal Rivera: Applying rollback to metering-reader: `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/metering-reader metering-reader=registry/redwood/metering-reader:v2.1.8`
Jamal Rivera: rolling back and bringing replicas up.
incident-bot: Deploy job started by jamal. Job ID: deploy-1769456160.
Priya Patel: Observing consumer lag dropping after additional replicas. Current lag by partition: [p0: 45k, p1: 38k, p2: 12k] -> trending down.
Sofia Chen: Token-count drift: sample comparison between production counts and raw log-based tokenizer shows ~27% undercount after tokenizer v3.0.0 upgrade. Need to re-run tokenization on raw payloads for 14:30-15:30 window.
Marcus Li: Running query to identify affected requests: 
```
SELECT request_id, user_id, raw_input, reported_tokens, ts
FROM billing_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10T14:30:00Z' AND '2026-03-10T15:30:00Z'
  AND source = 'metering-reader';
```
Marcus Li: Dumping sample set for re-tokenization.
Priya Patel: While backlog drains, we should avoid double-billing. Add dedupe marker on reprocessed events: tag `reproc_run=1769456`.
Jamal Rivera: Good call. I'll run the reprocess job in batches: 10k events at a time, dedupe by event_uid. Command: 
```
./tools/reprocess_metering --start 2026-03-10T14:30Z --end 2026-03-10T15:30Z --batch-size 10000 --tag reproc_run=1769456
```
Sofia Chen: I kicked off the tokenization re-run on a sample of 5k events. New token counts align with expected baseline (previous prod before v3.0.0) — difference corrected.
billing-sre: Alert: Billing pipeline internal metric `billing.tokens_reconciled` incremented to 5200 after sample backfill.
Priya Patel: Good. Proceed with full reprocess once backlog < 20k. Jamal, keep me posted on progress and any consumer errors.
Jamal Rivera: Backlog now 9k total across partitions. Reprocess script started. ETA to finish full reprocess ~ 18 minutes.
incident-bot: Note: we created incident timeline entry and assigned `billing-reconciliation` run for oncall.
Marcus Li: CS: list of customers affected (prelim): acct_842, acct_1291, acct_4912. Re: messaging, we'll send a targeted note explaining delay & that any overage flags will be removed. Drafting now.
customer-success-bot: Draft ready for review: "We detected an ingestion delay and token-counting mismatch that caused temporary overage flags. No charges have been applied; we're reversing the flags and reconciling usage. Expect update within 24 hours."
Marcus Li: I approve. Sending to affected customers after reprocess completes.
Sofia Chen: Reprocess finished. Reconciled ~64k events. Token counts corrected, new billing totals differ for ~0.9% of events (mostly high-LLM tokens).
Jamal Rivera: Recomputed charges and removed `overage_flag` for affected accounts. Re-enabled enforcement?
Priya Patel: Wait to re-enable until billing records are fully reconciled and end-to-end tests pass. I'll run the smoke test on billing ingestion -> quota pipeline.
Priya Patel: Smoke test pass. Re-enabling `billing.enforce_overages = true` in 5m after monitoring confirms no regression.
Priya Patel: Flag re-enabled. Monitoring green.
incident-bot: Incident resolved by Priya, jamal, sofia, marcus. Severity: SEV2. Timeline saved.
Marcus Li: Postmortem actions: (1) Pin tokenizer dep in metering-reader CI (PR in progress), (2) Add automated canary to detect tokenization delta between versions, (3) Add auto-pause for overage emails when downstream backlog > 20k, (4) Improve runbook for reprocess + dedupe.
Priya Patel: I'll own (1) and (2). Jamal take (3). Marcus take (4) and customer comms.
Jamal Rivera: Acknowledged. I'll file follow-up tasks and link to this thread.
Marcus Li: Thanks team. Notifying legal for any potential billing disputes.
customer-success-bot: Notified affected customers with update.
Priya Patel: Closing the loop: no customer charges applied and flags reversed. Will include numbers in postmortem. Great work. :tada:
